name: Jarvis 17.0
notes: Work Sheet now looks like Excel: File, Home, Insert, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View and Help tabs with their groups (Clipboard, Font, Alignment, Number, Styles, Cells, Editing …). Select cells or a whole column to see Average, Count and Sum at the bottom, like Excel. Zoom slider, Merge & Center, AutoSum, Fill, Format Painter, Text to Columns, drop-down lists, comments, Protect Sheet, Show Formulas and page setup.
